name: Tiger's Claws
body:
Tiger's Claws (Ex)
Source Heroes of Golarion pg. 20
The vigilante gains the ability to grow claws similar to a shifter’s. These claws are natural weapons that can be extended at will and deal 1d4 points of piercing and slashing damage (1d3 if the vigilante is Small). At 11th level, the damage increases to 1d6 (1d4 if Small).
